Asian Investors Shift to Real Estate Amid Global Market Distrust

Asian investors are increasingly directing funds into real estate as global tensions erode confidence in financial markets. This shift reflects a broader distrust among investors, with France reportedly struggling to reassure its financial markets, a situation exacerbated by Asian investor sentiment.
